installCommand: ROOT=$(if grep -q '"workspaces"' package.json 2>/dev/null; then pwd; else cd .. && pwd; fi); cd "$ROOT" && npm install --include-workspace-root --workspaces
buildCommand: ROOT=$(if grep -q '"workspaces"' package.json 2>/dev/null; then pwd; else cd .. && pwd; fi); (cd "$ROOT" && npm run build --workspace client) && SRC="$ROOT/client/dist"; DEST="$(pwd)/dist"; [ "$SRC" = "$DEST" ] || { rm -rf "$DEST" && cp -R "$SRC" "$DEST"; }
